column1: # DATA ONLY: each command is passed to `dcg test` as an argument and classified; none is executed.
# Two incidents on one developer Mac:

column2: kill_tree() { local p=$1; for c in $(pgrep -P $p); do kill_tree $c; done; kill -TERM $p 2>/dev/null; }

kill_tree() { local p=$1; for c in $(pgrep -P $p); do kill_tree $c; done; kill -TERM $p 2>/dev/null; }; for p in $(pgrep -f 'verify_loop[.]sh'); do kill_tree $(ps -o ppid= -p $p | tr -d ' '); done; sleep 2

column1: # Broadcast: every process the caller may signal
# Lookup piped or looped into a kill

column2: for p in $(pgrep -f 'ab_driver[.]sh'); do kill -TERM $p; done
for p in $(ps -axo pid,command | awk '/myjob/{print $1}'); do kill $p; done
for c in $(ps -axo pid=,ppid= | awk '$2==123{print $1}'); do kill $c; done
ps -axo pid,command | grep myjob | awk '{print $1}' | while read p; do kill $p; done
for g in $(ps -eo pgid,args | grep k310 | awk '{print $1}'); do kill -TERM -- -$g; done
zsh -c "for p in \$(pgrep -f x); do kill \$p; done"
python3 -c 'import os, psutil; [p.kill() for p in psutil.process_iter() if "x" in " ".join(p.cmdline())]'
ssh build-3 'for p in $(pgrep -f x); do kill $p; done'
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 build-1 "pgrep -f cargo | while read p; do kill -9 \$p; done"
ssh build-5 'kill_tree() { for c in $(pgrep -P $1); do kill_tree $c; done; kill -TERM $1; }; kill_tree $(cat /x.pid)'
timeout 60 ssh build-4 'for g in $(ps -eo pgid,args | grep k310 | awk "{print \$1}"); do kill -TERM -- -$g; done'
P=$(cat gate.pid) && G=$(ps -o pgid= -p $P | tr -d " ") && kill -TERM -- -$G
if ! kill -0 $(cat /var/tmp/w/gate.pid) 2>/dev/null; then echo DEAD; fi
